subtopic: Auction Rate Securities Buybacks and Redemptions
source_evidence: These settlements included agreements to buy back ARS from certain investors.  In addition, many issuers of ARS have redeemed their ARS and converted to other types of securities.
question: After the ARS market collapsed, what buybacks or redemptions took place?
answer: Settlements with broker-dealers and other entities included agreements to buy back ARS from certain investors. Many ARS issuers also redeemed their securities and converted to other types of securities.
